paper_metadata.title: A 14-Bit High-Temperature Modulator in Standard CMOS
paper_metadata.abstract: Experimental verification is given for the use of modulation for high-temperature applications ( approximately 150 C) in a standard CMOS process. Switched-capacitor circuits are used to implement a second-order single-stage and a third-order 2-1 MASH modulator with single-bit quantization. The two modulators have an oversampling ratio of 256 with an input signal bandwidth of 500 Hz. The modulators were fabricated in a 1.5m standard CMOS technology. A fully differential signal path and near minimum sized switches are used to mitigate the effect of large junction-to-substrate leakage Fig. 1. Results show that the single-stage modulator is more resistant to high-temperature open-loop gain and increased comparator offset.
